objects.description: white solderless breadboard: two long power rails on each side (red line +, blue line -), five-hole rows split by a center gap
5 mm LED with a long leg (anode, +) and a short leg (cathode, -); the rim is flat on the cathode side
220 ohm resistor: small beige body with red-red-brown color bands and two wire legs
small square tactile push button with four legs
colored jumper wire with a pin at each end
AA battery holder with a red (+) and a black (-) lead ending in pins

actions.label_es: poner el pulsador en la protoboard
actions.visual_cue: the square push button is pressed into the breadboard straddling the center gap, two legs on each side

actions.label_es: poner el pulsador sin cruzar el canal
actions.visual_cue: the push button sits entirely on one side of the center gap instead of across it
the beige banded resistor is pushed into the breadboard with its two legs in two different rows, one leg in the button's row

actions.label_es: poner la resistencia en una sola fila
actions.visual_cue: both legs of the resistor are pushed into the same five-hole row, so it lies along the row instead of bridging two rows
the LED is pushed into the breadboard with its long leg in the resistor's row and its short leg in a separate row
the LED's short leg (flat side of the rim) is in the resistor's row and the long leg is in the other row

actions.label_es: conectar el riel positivo al pulsador
actions.visual_cue: a jumper wire runs from the red (+) power rail to the row of one of the button's legs

actions.label_es: conectar el LED al riel negativo
actions.visual_cue: a jumper wire runs from the LED's short-leg row to the blue (-) power rail

actions.label_es: conectar el portapilas a los rieles
actions.visual_cue: the battery holder's red lead is pushed into the red (+) rail and the black lead into the blue (-) rail
the battery holder's red lead is in the blue (-) rail and the black lead in the red (+) rail
a finger presses the push button and the LED lights up while it is held
